units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Five things to take with you. Give me the short version.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Antwerp is a river port with a legend about a hand.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: It got rich because Bruges silted up and the merchants came.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: It lost much of it to a sack, a siege, and a closed river.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: It came back with docks and railways.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: That the river made it, broke it, and made it again.
